style: ONE isolated game prop illustration for Terminus, Coreto style. Match reference ART TECHNIQUE only unless the subject explicitly asks to preserve an object: bold pure-black contours, warm monochrome sepia cream fills, crosshatching and stippling, high-contrast medieval hand-inked engraving. Light from upper left. True transparent background; no scenery, ground, external cast shadow, characters, hands, UI, caption, frame around canvas, watermark or readable text. Entire object centered in landscape 4:3 canvas, at least 8% free margins, readable at small display size. One finished asset, no grid or variants. Subject:

subjects.obj-mapa-entrada: Landscape parchment map: narrow entry opening on left, path toward one fork on right, arrow pointing toward fork; unfinished branches, only schematic annotation strokes.
subjects.obj-mapa-retirada: Second landscape parchment map. Preserve the reference map's same narrow opening on left and SAME fork with two branches on right. Arrow now points LEFT toward the narrow opening, indicating withdrawal. Change paper edge shape and folds to distinguish sheets, leave the unexplored branch unfinished. Do not mirror the landmarks, add passages or suggest fraud.
subjects.quest-lista-patio: A checked courtyard dispatch list: tall cream sheet with five uneven rows of small box pictograms and checkmarks, horizontal crease and folded bottom corner; no letters or numbers.
subjects.quest-etiquetas-patio: One compact group of four small rectangular cream dispatch tags, punched holes and short twine ties, each with a distinct abstract geometric mark, no text, clearly separate readable silhouettes.
subjects.quest-registro-retirada: Anonymous evacuation record copy: one cream paper sheet with a ruled table, short abstract ink strokes and small route symbols; no identifying names or signatures, no redaction bars implying withheld evidence.
subjects.quest-apontamentos-a: Cartographer's notes for the healer: single sheet with a narrow route diagram and a tiny stretcher pictogram showing passage clearance, marginal arrows, short abstract ink strokes, no words.
subjects.quest-pedido-maca: Material loan request: folded cream sheet opened flat, tiny line drawing of a stretcher and two trestle supports above a short item checklist, no signatures or text.
subjects.quest-maca: A complete empty medieval demonstration rescue stretcher, two long wooden carrying poles with handles extending at BOTH ends, taut sturdy linen bed and two low removable wooden trestle supports visible beneath, three-quarter view. Unoccupied, no straps covering a person, no modern wheels or medical symbols.
subjects.quest-recibo-maca: Small loan receipt on cream parchment, one minimal stretcher outline with two support marks, three rows of abstract ink strokes and a plain circular merchant verification mark, no heraldry or text.
subjects.quest-lista-virmura: Healer's supply list: narrow cream sheet with small bandage-roll and folded-cloth pictograms beside four short checklist rows, a shallow fold; no medical crosses, words or names.
subjects.quest-bolsa-materiais: One open practical coarse-linen supply satchel with leather strap, two rolled bandages, folded clean washing cloth and small plain clay washing-material container visible inside. No modern medical logos or glass syringes; all contents form one compact prop.
subjects.quest-registro-carga: Authorized cargo record copy: wide cream ledger sheet with tidy columns, small crate and rope-coil pictograms, abstract tally strokes and simple circular merchant check mark, no names or numbers.
subjects.quest-apontamentos-b: Cartographer's notes for the cargo guild: cream sheet with a route sketch, tiny crate pictogram at a turning point, directional arrows and abstract annotations; no new geography, words or emblems.
subjects.quest-fardo: Recovered cargo bundle: thick coiled hemp rope bound neatly to a bundle of sturdy short wooden marking stakes with blunt capped tops and pointed lower ends. Practical worn materials, compact three-quarter view, no weapon or magic.
subjects.quest-recibo-fardo: Small folded cargo-return receipt with tiny rope-coil and bundled-stake pictograms, short abstract rows and plain circular merchant check mark; no names or monetary values.
subjects.quest-ataduras: Compact packet of clean linen bandages: three rolled strips together with folded spare cloth, tied crosswise with plain twine. No blood, medical crosses or labels.
subjects.quest-recibo-ataduras: Small arena delivery confirmation slip, tiny bandage-roll pictogram, two abstract ink rows and a bold check mark inside a plain circle. No heraldry, words or signature.
subjects.quest-procedimento: Training procedure copy: tall cream sheet with three simple sequential mechanical-position diagrams using rods, angles and joint circles, abstract strokes below each. No people, words or numbers. Leave generous margins for later revision.
subjects.quest-apontamentos-c: Revised copy of the reference training procedure. Preserve its same three mechanical-position diagrams and page arrangement; add restrained margin arrows and brief abstract correction strokes, folded upper-right corner. No names, words or new equipment.
subjects.quest-estojo: Closed elongated training-equipment case in worn brown leather, simple rigid rectangular body, rounded corners, two buckled closure straps and small carrying loop. Contents hidden; no weapon, emblem, text or elaborate ornament.
subjects.quest-apoios: A compact grouped set of sturdy portable wooden evacuation supports: two low braced trestles and a few crosspieces tied for transport with rope; squared wood joints and restrained metal fasteners, no machinery or modern tools.
subjects.quest-carga-leve: Light exploration bundle: small tied canvas roll, thin hemp cord coil and several short plain wooden route markers. Compact portable kit clearly lighter than the large rope-and-stake cargo bundle. No runes or magic.
subjects.quest-levantamento: Mine survey report: two overlapping cream sheets, top sheet has a schematic partial branching route, short ruled observation rows and a visibly blank unexplored region. No invented complete mine layout, labels or numbers.
subjects.quest-recibo-dam: Personal remittance record copy: small carefully folded cream merchant receipt, abstract transaction rows, simple verification circle and checked field. No amounts, currency, names, political symbol or new seal.
subjects.quest-autorizacao-r2: Authorization to inspect a damaged training support: cream paper with a small schematic support bracket drawing, two abstract text blocks and a plain checked approval field. No patient name, signature or official insignia.
subjects.quest-relato-anonimo: Anonymous witness account copy: single modest cream sheet with short abstract handwriting strokes arranged in two paragraphs, clean blank header, simple fold. No names, identifying workplace, signature, portraits or censored black bars.
subjects.quest-peca-avariada: Preserved fragment of a failed training equipment support: short broken wooden structural brace with a plain iron joining bracket and old fastening holes. One clear splintered fracture shows failure; no fresh tool cuts, blood, sabotage clues or weapon. A small mechanically plausible component, three-quarter view.
subjects.quest-nota-condicao: Craftsman's condition note on cream sheet: a small technical sketch of the SAME broken wooden brace and iron bracket in reference, fine arrows to existing fracture and fastening holes, brief abstract observation strokes. No accusation, name, signature or text.
subjects.quest-autorizacao-armacao: Permission to present a collective wooden-and-metal articulated frame: single broad cream document, small schematic jointed frame in upper half, short abstract rows and checked field below. No heraldry, words or new mechanical powers.
subjects.quest-contas-cisterna: Copy of wages owed: cream ledger sheet with ruled rows and two columns of abstract tally strokes, modest wear and central fold. No legible numbers, sums, names or currency.
subjects.quest-deposito: Verified deposit receipt with release conditions: cream folded document opened flat, two clearly separate blocks of abstract ink strokes, checked box and plain circular merchant verification mark. No coins, money, readable amounts, names or official crest.
subjects.quest-chave-cisterna: One sturdy plain old iron cistern key, large oval bow, long cylindrical shaft, rectangular bit with two simple notches, worn brown-black metal. Diagonal three-quarter view, fully visible, no label, chain, magic or ornament.
subjects.quest-programa: Public presentation program: cream folded leaflet opened to two panels, a short sequence of abstract ink lines and small plain circular markers, restrained double-line border. No portraits, performers, letters, numbers, emblems or specific chosen outcome.
subjects.quest-correspondencia: Supplier correspondence found in crates: two cream paper letters with abstract handwriting strokes, one open folded wrapper partly behind them. No legible names, map, secret insignia, incriminating new details or wax seal. Make arrangement identifiable for a matching preserved copy.
subjects.quest-copia-correspondencia: Preserved copy of the reference supplier correspondence: reproduce same top page abstract paragraph arrangement on a cleaner single cream sheet with a second plain backing sheet and subtle copy margins, without envelope. No added words, names, seals or revelations.
